agentGuidance.corePurpose: Authoring definitions and runtime effect instances. The active-effect controller is supplied as an optional Samples~ example, not as a core runtime type.
recommendedFlow: Create an EffectDefinition asset or a derived asset type.
Implement a serializable RuntimeEffect subclass and an EffectFactory subclass.
Create a new effect with factory.Create().
Pass the effect to an owner-side controller such as the sample EffectsController.AddEffect().
Call RuntimeEffect.Dispose() when removing an active instance; Dispose invokes OnRemove and destroys its cloned EffectDefinition.
lifecycleOrder: EffectFactory.Create constructs a new runtime object and clones the source EffectDefinition.
EffectsController.AddEffect calls RuntimeEffect.Initialize(owner) for both instant and continuous effects.
The effect is stored for Countdown or Passive lifetime types; Instant effects are not stored.
For every active continuous effect, EffectsController invokes OnUpdate(Time.deltaTime).
When IsFinished becomes true, or when explicitly removed, EffectsController calls Dispose().
Dispose calls OnRemove exactly once per effect instance and destroys the per-instance ScriptableObject clone.
importantRules: Never mutate the original authoring EffectDefinition to store a runtime value. RuntimeEffect.Data is a per-instance clone.
RuntimeEffect.Data remains a public field for Unity SerializeReference compatibility; treat it as read-only outside the effect implementation.
Call Initialize before OnApply; Owner is null before initialization.
Create one RuntimeEffect instance per application; do not reuse a disposed instance or apply it to another owner.
EffectsController is an optional sample implementation. Projects may implement their own controller.
The sample controller stacks effects by concrete runtime Type, not by EffectDefinition asset identity.
Instant effects are initialized, applied, and disposed immediately; use them for immediate one-shot operations.
The sample controller uses Time.deltaTime. Pausing with Time.timeScale = 0 stops countdown progress.

coreTypes.name: EffectDefinition

fields.name: Value
fields.purpose: Per-runtime-instance display/value slot; copied with the asset clone.

fields.name: MaxStackSize
fields.purpose: Maximum simultaneous runtime instances of the same concrete effect type in the sample controller.

fields.name: Levels
fields.purpose: Maximum level supported by the effect; the base constructor clamps initial Level.

fields.name: VFX
fields.purpose: Optional visual-effect prefab. The core system does not instantiate it.

fields.name: SFX
fields.purpose: Optional sound asset. The core system does not play it.

coreTypes.extensionPattern: Derive from EffectDefinition and add serialized configuration fields, for example BaseDamage or ScaleFactor.

methods.name: Create
methods.purpose: Returns a new runtime instance. The caller owns its application/removal lifecycle.

coreTypes.name: RuntimeEffect

values.name: Instant
values.meaning: Applied once; not retained by the sample controller.

values.name: Countdown
values.meaning: Continuous finite lifetime; removed when IsFinished is true.

values.name: Passive
values.meaning: Continuous lifetime; remains until explicitly removed or finished.

members.name: Data
members.purpose: Per-instance cloned definition; public field retained for SerializeReference compatibility.

members.name: Level
members.purpose: Runtime level. Consumer must enforce level changes against Data.Levels.

members.name: LifecicleType
members.note: Original misspelling retained for source compatibility.

members.name: OnApply
members.rule: Call after Initialize; implement gameplay application.

members.name: Initialize
members.rule: Assigns Owner; rejects null and a different second owner.

members.name: OnRemove
members.rule: Release effect-specific resources; invoked by Dispose.

members.name: Dispose
members.rule: Idempotent; invokes OnRemove and destroys cloned Data.

exceptions: ArgumentNullException for a null definition in the constructor or a null owner in Initialize.
InvalidOperationException when initialized for a different owner.
ObjectDisposedException when Initialize or protected lifecycle guard is used after disposal.

sampleTypes.name: EffectsController

members.name: Effects
members.purpose: Read-only view of active continuous effects.

members.name: OnContinuousEffectsChanged
members.purpose: Raised whenever the active continuous list changes.

members.name: AddEffect
members.purpose: Initializes every effect, enforces stack policy for continuous types, applies it, and immediately disposes instant effects.

members.name: RemoveEffect
members.purpose: Removes the active instance and disposes it.

sampleTypes.stackPolicy: Effects are grouped by GetType(). Non-stackable effects have cap 1; stackable effects use incoming Data.MaxStackSize; oldest matching effects are removed first.

sampleTypes.name: InstantDamageEffect
sampleTypes.apply: Applies BaseDamage to Health on owner and marks IsFinished.

sampleTypes.name: DamageOverTimeEffect
sampleTypes.apply: Starts IntervalTimer; applies BaseDamage to owner Health for each interval tick.

sampleTypes.name: ChangeScaleEffect
sampleTypes.apply: Stores original localScale, applies ScaleFactor, and restores original localScale on removal.

sampleTypes.name: PlayerEffectsUIBootstrap
sampleTypes.purpose: Subscribes to EffectsController and creates/removes effect UI views. Requires effect prefab with PlayerEffectView.

sampleTypes.name: Health
sampleTypes.purpose: Example health target used by sample damage effects. Not part of core runtime.

exampleImplementation: [Serializable] public sealed class MyEffect : RuntimeEffect { public override EffectLifeType LifecicleType => EffectLifeType.Passive; public MyEffect(MyEffectDefinition data) : base(data) {} public override void OnApply() { ThrowIfDisposed(); if (!IsInitialized || Owner == null) throw new InvalidOperationException(); /* apply */ } public override void OnRemove() { /* restore state / stop timers */ } }
compatibilityNotes: Sample namespace: LOGIYGames.EffectSystem.Examples (except ChangeScaleEffect and ScalingEffectFactory which retain global namespace compatibility).
Core asmdef remains unchanged and has no references listed.
The public LifecycleType alias is added while retaining the original LifecicleType spelling.
